entities.summary: Sisteron Cathedral, now the Church of Notre-Dame-des Pommiers is a Roman Catholic church located in Sisteron, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, France. It was formerly a cathedral, and is a national monument. Sisteron Cathedral is a cathedral in Europe, established in 1160. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
